slides.headline: One Man Designed [[The Royal Oak]] And The Nautilus.

slides.text: Gérald Genta was born in Geneva in 1931 and died in 2011.
Inspired by vintage diving helmets, with exposed screws.
Patek Philippe launched the Nautilus in 1976.
slides.credit: Image: Patek Philippe SA, CC BY-SA 4.0

slides.text: Genta also designed IWC's Ingenieur, from 1976.
Around 1985, Cartier asked Genta to redesign the Pasha.
